Title: MCP Integration Friction
Content: VS Code MCP configuration pointed at MemorySmith before the app exposed an MCP endpoint, which caused /mcp probes to return 404 or 405. MemorySmith should expose a small HTTP MCP-compatible JSON-RPC endpoint with tools for keyword search, semantic search, and record lookup. The workspace .vscode/mcp.json should point directly at http://localhost:5089/mcp.
